significance: Three explicit one-edge closures answer Levit and Kadrawi’s Problem 6.6 for both named tree constructions.
prior_work: The tree constructions are due to Bautista-Ramos and to Bautista-Ramos, Guillén-Galván and Gómez-Salgado. Levit and Kadrawi’s Theorem 5.1 already treats single-break closures for other parameters. Here the additional edge preserves multiple breaks. The search found no earlier matching resolution; priority remains undetermined. [Problem 6.6](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.17114v1#S6)
